verified_contracts: single exact conversation task bypasses RAG and TaskContextAgent
different conversation and wording can select a retrieved task context
low-confidence decision rewrites the query and retries exactly once
ambiguity after retry fails closed to ASK_USER
task IDs outside retrieved candidates are rejected
Task Context API or schema failure does not change a task
recent user decisions are included in bounded task memory
retrieved task status, recent mail count, history count, and user-decision count are recorded as safe observation evidence
completion, cancellation, and due-date reduction retain user approval gates
post-action stored state is observed and recorded
technical trace UI renders without a Streamlit exception

baseline_comparison.case: different conversation, different requester, and no lexical token overlap
baseline_comparison.agentic_rag_result: UPDATE_TASK for the selected retrieved candidate
baseline_comparison.interpretation: The test proves the routing and guard contract, not production mailbox accuracy.

results.expected: AMBIGUOUS, ASK_USER, and a rewritten query
AMBIGUOUS and ASK_USER after the retry limit

limitations: Live checks use three synthetic cases and do not represent real mailbox-wide accuracy.
The trace stores concise decision evidence and does not expose private chain-of-thought.
Knowledge-document RAG, vector search, and company Outlook integration remain outside this MVP.
